# Fact Ledger: Session 1 The four stages

Format: `[ID] | fact | type | slide`

## 1. The stages (slides 2-6)

- [W01-001] | The four stages in order: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, collection | Ranking | 2
- [W01-002] | Evaporation: liquid water turns into water vapour, driven by heat from the sun | Definition | 3
- [W01-003] | Condensation: water vapour cools and turns into tiny droplets, which form clouds | Definition | 4
- [W01-004] | Precipitation: water falls from clouds as rain, snow, sleet or hail | Definition | 5
- [W01-005] | Collection: water gathers in oceans, lakes, rivers and underground | Definition | 6
